requirement_evidence.evidence: LIPSCHITZ.md §2 and bounds.py derive exact Euclidean operator norms for all 15 layers of SmallCNN1D: Conv (via adjoint power iteration), BN (max scaling), Pool (factor <= 1.0), Flatten (isometry), Linear1 (spectral norm), and Linear2 (pairwise Euclidean difference norms ||Wc - Wj||_2). Preserves full 12x12 matrix with 11 non-target competitor constants. Verified by test_c01_operator_norm_declarations_and_pairwise_constants.

BatchNorm eval scaling verified as max |gamma/sqrt(var+eps)| for each BN layer (3.0539, 3.1434, 3.1684). MaxPool norm factor proved <= 1.0 under L2. Global upper bound used exclusively without local gradient approximations. Verified by test_c02_bn_scaling_and_pool_norm_factor.

Diagonal L[c, c] = 0.0 handled. On near-tie control witness row 13358 (margin 1.13487e-4), certified radius R2 = Delta / L collapses to 2.26e-7, yielding CONDITIONAL_INCONCLUSIVE for any practical perturbation. Point domain (r2=0) on confident sample yields CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE. Verified by test_c03_boundary_near_zero_margins_and_radius_collapse.

Numerical status strictly recorded as CONDITIONAL_REAL_ARITHMETIC. Bounds are derived under real-arithmetic spectral theory and cannot be upgraded to formal float32 certificates. Verified by test_c04_numerical_status_conditional_scope.

LipschitzConstants computed once via compute_smallcnn1d_lipschitz_constants, cached on BoundEngine, and bound to ReferenceOwner.identity_id and checkpoint_sha256. Per-query evaluation is O(1). Verified by test_c05_one_time_constant_setup_and_caching.

Power iteration verified on analytic 1x1 synthetic convolution layer matching exact closed-form eigenvalue. Verified zero imports or reuse of obsolete GAP model constants from ecdr.certified_adaptive. Verified by test_c06_analytic_power_iteration_and_no_gap_model_imports.

LIPSCHITZ.md §5 and lipschitz_capability.json confirm H06 and H19: global Lipschitz constant L ~ 500 severely compresses certified radii (R <= 0.007 for Delta=2.0). Since physical inter-window displacements on HAPT streams exceed 0.2, global Lipschitz yields 0% singleton reuse. Verified by test_c07_h06_and_h19_scientific_evaluation.

scientific_dispositions: Confirms H06: Global Lipschitz constants (~500) derived from product of spectral norms are highly conservative, compressing certified radii below useful physical thresholds.
Confirms H19: Certified singletons have virtually zero future coverage in continuous sensor streams due to physical displacement exceeding R_safe by multiple orders of magnitude.
Confirms H21: Historical constants from simplified GAP models do not apply to SmallCNN1D.
Confirms H22: Lipschitz bounds operate under real-arithmetic conditional semantics.
limitations: Global Lipschitz bounds provide fast O(1) evaluation but suffer from severe over-conservatism (L ~ 500).
Designated as CONDITIONAL_REAL_ARITHMETIC baseline for comparison against IBP and CROWN; cannot issue formal float32 certificates.
